note: Wooded park 3 miles from Bagnell Dam, a mile off the highway on a country road, with a strong seasonal community (seasonal sites April-October with winter storage on site). Sites 61-64 face the private 10-acre fishing lake across the park road; no swimming or wading in the lake. Pool Memorial Day-Labor Day, mini-golf. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $45 (lakefront $50, 4 people), RoverPass booking, holiday 3-night minimum, 30/50A full hookups; added season Apr 17-Oct 25, 51 sites to 42 ft, showers/laundry/store; lakeview stays (the 'lakefront' sites are across the park road from the lake).
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted 2026/2027 rate $45 a night (4 people) for back-in and pull-through, $50 lakefront/holiday - under $50, passes. Gateway: none within 40 km (Branson 185 km) - not needed. Good Sam: operator silent, no stored value. Presence: operator site with phone 573-365-1211 and a claimed, bookable RoverPass engine; Google Maps 4.6 stars, 205 reviews; RV Life 5 stars, 30 reviews, $$ ('Cross Creek RV Park & Campground', Lake Ozark).

LONG-STAY (the home page leads with 'Seasonal Sites' and 'The Seasonal community here at Cross Creek RV Park is the best at the Lake'; 'We have availability for Seasonal/Yearly campers'): (1) price $45 - pass; (2) nights sold on RoverPass with no application or approval - pass; (3) minimum: 2 nights on the back-in and lakefront rates on every date read, 1 night on pull-through 53, 3 on holiday weeks - pass (no minimum over 2 outside holidays); (4) occupancy for two-night stays from Tue 2027-05-11 and Tue 2027-06-15: 8 RV sites open (back-in 5, 22, 24, 36, 65; lakefront 61, 62; pull-through 53) plus 9-10 tent sites, of 51 RV sites on the map - about 16% of RV sites and 18 of ~61 sites overall sold nightly - pass; (5) no homes or lots for sale - pass. Mostly seasonal in character but passes all five tests; not a drop by my reading.

WATERFRONT: lakeview stays. The operator calls sites 61-64 'Lakefront RV Sites' with 'a front water view of our private 10-acre lake' - a lead toward lakefront, but the 2026 map puts Old Trail Dr (the campground's own road) and a treed bank between those pads and the shore, so lakeview at best under the 2026-11-01 ruling. Imagery shows the lake ~230 x 200 m (about 10 acres, above the pond line).
